name: @engine/view-models
description: Every surface's view model (C2), the content-block union (C4), the loader signatures and typed fixtures for every surface. Types and fixtures only: no runtime dependency, so apps build against fixtures and never against the database. One entry for the contract (`@engine/view-models`), one for the fixtures (`@engine/view-models/fixtures`); `./<module>` reaches a single file.
